description.value: Firehouse Subs is a North American sandwich chain with a public-safety theme, known for hot subs piled with premium meats and toppings. This Victoria location sits in a retail unit and serves the standard Firehouse menu. For touring cyclists passing through the area, it offers a reliably familiar stop for a substantial hot meal.
